tagline: Architectural calm, coastal light, and a grounded sense of place.
rationale: A framed abstract coastal landscape and structural numbered rows create order and local atmosphere without stock forest photography.
mobile: Window stacks after introductory copy; numbered process rows collapse into readable two-column markers and text.
supporting: Anchored biography, process and expanded logistics; additional services can become dedicated pages after scope is confirmed.
trust: Clear hierarchy and practical answers reduce ambiguity; an authentic portrait establishes the actual practitioner.
seo: Text remains live HTML; local context is explicit but not keyword-stuffed. Confirm actual practice location before adding structured data.
tradeoff: Dark hero feels assured but may be too formal for a highly playful brand; requires good-quality portrait photography.
name: Pacific Architecture
accessibility: Light text on the navy hero needs sufficient contrast. Window artwork carries no essential content. Preserve visible link focus and ensure dividers are not the only indication of section boundaries.
